title: Team-scoped hiring workflow
codebase_type: Python simulation service with SQLAlchemy persistence and an HTTP API
change_scope: Four production modules connect durable candidate records, team-specific generation, deterministic vote resolution and an eligible-target API.
testing_approach: The regression suite uses deterministic randomness, SQLite-backed candidate records, isolated team fixtures and an API read. It checks candidate reuse and quality spread, vote filtering, cross-team isolation, tie and no-vote decisions, cleanup, and nearby existing behavior.
attribution: Original simulation feature contribution: aknous, with AI assistance credited upstream. Portfolio contribution: task adaptation and regression tests by Saketh Thumuluri, with AI assistance.
